notes: Units were aligned by source passage. Coder B often merged a permission and the following requirement from the same sample statement into one unit; these were split into separate units (counted as only_A, kept). Main disagreements: policy_type for 'define what AI may be used for' (P09 vs P04, resolved to P04 because the text names no syllabus), reflection assignments (P35 vs P26), the plagiarism definition quoted from the Academic Integrity Policy (P36 vs P19, resolved to P36 and phase general), 'should not be used as an academic source' (P03 vs P31, resolved to P03), and the clarify-the-extent sentence (P04 vs P10, resolved to P04). Phase agreement shares are lowest where a single sentence could be read as course set-up or communication.
